descriptiveLanguage.description: Use vivid adjectives and adverbs to paint a picture

informativeTone.description: Focus on clarity and factual information

engagingQuestions.description: Pose rhetorical questions to provoke thought

examples: Photosynthesis is the process by which...

persuasiveLanguage.description: Use compelling adjectives and action verbs

examples: Join our community of satisfied customers!

characterSpecific.description: Tailor language to reflect character backgrounds and personalities

emotionalExpression.description: Use expressive language to convey feelings
examples: I can't believe this is happening!

imageryAndMetaphors.description: Employ figurative language to enhance storytelling
examples: Her smile was like sunshine on a rainy day

professionalTone.description: Use formal vocabulary suitable for a corporate audience
examples: We aim to enhance productivity through...

industryJargon.description: Incorporate relevant terminology that resonates with the target audience

personalAnecdotes.description: Include personal stories or experiences for relatability

examples: Let me know what you think in the comments!
